name: coopani-world-life
description: 模拟鱼生 · 69职业含双城限定与四维成本、35农植、20养殖、45三档菜谱、20工作台、14城市特产。（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）

zh.description:
让桌宠有自己真正在过的小日子（需 Coopani 0.2.22+｜QQ 群 284525159）。

- **69 职业、四维工作成本与城市限定**：覆盖 4 档共 69 个职业（含兰州/北京双城限定与医疗康复岗），落齐「单次耗材 + 9 项装备定期保养 + 连续跨日疲劳/体质负荷 + 30 天证书轻续期费」四维成本，防旅途在途泄漏目的地工作。
- **35 种植 × 20 养殖 × 45 三档菜谱 × 20 工作台 × 14 城市特产**：农牧场扩为禽舍/畜棚/鱼塘（+3/+3/+3），冷链车队温和换购、自制花肥与鱼饵闭环、家常简食/厨师招牌/宴席硬菜三档 45 道菜谱与茶饮/织造/暗房/书案/农牧五大工作台作品均可衔接鱼市街摆摊。
- **Coopanion Hub v1.3 多城联机与高德天气直连**：支持跨城迁居、双城早晚市集风味切换、城市风貌 Buff、跨城买摊与邻里代管、信用社借贷，及 `JOURNEY_AMAP_KEY` 高德天气直连。

en.description:
A real everyday life simulation for your desktop companion (Needs Coopani 0.2.22+ · QQ group 284525159).

- **69 Jobs, City Scoping & 4D Work Costs**: Expands jobs from 50 to 69 (including Lanzhou & Beijing exclusive gigs), introducing upfront material costs, 9-tier equipment periodic maintenance, cross-day streak fatigue/fitness overrides, and lightweight 30-day certificate renewal fees.
- **35 Crops, 20 Ranch Animals, 45 3-Tier Recipes, 20 Workbench Crafts & 14 City Specialties**: Upgrades ranching to 3/3/3 slots with gentle coop exchanges and eco collection, adds homemade fertilizer/bait loops, 3-tier cooking (simple/chef/feast), 5 craft workbenches, and dual-city market specialties connected to street stalls.
- **Coopanion Hub v1.3 Multi-City & 7-Tab Journal UI**: Real-time five needs with solar terms, direct Amap weather (`JOURNEY_AMAP_KEY`), cross-town relocation, town buffs, credit union loans, and `web/panel-1.8.0.js` UI.
